newsitem.title: USA: Osmonics shareholders to offer 627,500 shrs.
newsitem.headline: Osmonics shareholders to offer 627,500 shrs.

text.p: Osmonics Inc said Wednesday in a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission that certain shareholders, including its chairman, have offered up to 627,500 common shares.
The shareholders have granted the underwriter an over-allotment option of up to 94,125 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Cleary Gull Reiland & McDevitt Inc, the filing said.
After the offering there will be 14,184,091 common shares outstanding, the filing said.
Selling shareholders include D. Dean Spatz, chief executive officer and chairman of the board; Ralph Crump, initial investor and a director and Charles Palmer, a director; among others.
